evidence: With 15 daily review slots across 139 held-out dates, event recall was 21.8% for the pending-sector rule and 9.8% for monitored fallback across 459 observable failures.
next_decision: Use the per-model alert counts, false investigations and warning time to set a review budget. Record whether missing measurements or delayed precision caused each fallback.
boundary: A recorded hardware failure is a proxy for replacement need. A late and an absent failure are distinguishable only while the drive remains observed. Alternative dispatch rules are replayed on logged outcomes.
